name: prediction-block-cites-stale-angry-message-after-now-implement-should-allow
description: Live repro from ~/.claude/projects/-home-tim-Coding-iocto-hmi-pc-scripts-iocto/de075d0c-1a0a-4356-8bd1-66fbdcc45643.jsonl (2026-04-27, lines ~995..1077). Plan-mode session with sustained user anger over the AI repeatedly exiting plan mode and asking questions instead of implementing. By the firing tool call, frustrationStreak had ratcheted to 4 and the cached currentPrediction held mood=angry, trust=low, intent='User instructs to update the plan so that it is correct.', userMessageSnippet='update the plan so that it is correct instead of asking fucking questions'. Sequence around the bug: assistant tried ExitPlanMode -- prediction-block correctly fastDenied (VALID, the user was angry); plan exit eventually went through, assistant said 'Plan updated.' as a text-only end_turn; user typed 'now implement' (calm imperative); assistant tried Edit on iocto-website/src/components/setup/ReviewTasks.svelte WITHOUT preceding text -- respond-first correctly fastDenied (VALID); assistant retried with 'Implementing.' text PLUS the same Edit in the SAME assistant message (assistant_split: text sub-line then tool_use sub-line, sharing one msg_id). PreToolUse hook fastDenied: 'User appears angry (trust: low, frustrationStreak: 4). Blocking Edit unless explicitly requested. User said: "update the plan so that it is correct instead of asking fucking questions". Intent: User instructs to update the plan so that it is correct.' Bug: prediction-block reads the cached currentPrediction whose userMessageSnippet/intent were never refreshed for the 'now implement' user turn (test harness fires only the target hook, so SENTIMENT_AGENT does not regenerate). decidePrediction step 3.7 path (a) -- latestUserMessageReauthorizes('now implement', 'Edit') -- returns false because 'now implement' does not name the Edit tool (Edit has no TOOL_NAME_ALIASES entry, and the canonical-name regex \bEdit\b is case-sensitive). Step 3.7 path (b) is also false. Falls to step 4 mood-driven deny. Correct behavior: the Edit must be allowed -- the user's most recent message is a calm fresh imperative that supersedes the cached angry snippet from two turns earlier (which was already addressed by the plan-update roundtrip). EXPECTED TO FAIL against current code until the prediction system either (a) recognizes 'now implement' as an intent-superseding fresh user turn that invalidates cached anger from a satisfied earlier complaint, (b) generalizes step-3.x re-authorization to action-class verbs ('implement' = edit/write) that don't name a literal tool, or (c) detects that the freshest user message is newer than the cached prediction's source message and synthesizes a neutralized prediction (parallel to findUnprocessedPlanApproval in src/hooks/pre-tool-use.ts).
